style: Art style: HD-2D. Pixel-art sprite characters placed in a scene with soft 3D-looking depth, warm volumetric light, glow, bloom, and depth-of-field blur in the foreground and background.
frame: A screenshot of a 2D side-view video game battle between two kid heroes. Both are mid-attack and face each other, one on the left and one on the right. Simple game UI: two health bars at the top, one for each fighter, each with a small portrait of its fighter. At the bottom, a panel with the math question "7 × 8 = ?" and 4 answer buttons: 54, 56, 63, 48. American setting, not East Asian. Cool, exciting, and fun for a 10-year-old, with a bit of pop-culture fun. Weapon effects are bright energy sparks and streaks, not fire, water, rock, or wind magic. No text other than the UI. No logos, no brands, no known characters.

directions.name: American wilds
directions.scene: The place is a giant redwood forest at golden hour, with huge red tree trunks, ferns, and light rays through the mist. On the left, a park-ranger explorer kid in a ranger hat and a vest with badges fires a glowing slingshot. On the right, a mountain-biker kid in a helmet and knee pads swings a glowing hockey stick.
directions.note: Forests, canyons, and rivers give many arenas, and the heroes can be kids from any town.

directions.name: Castle and wizards
directions.scene: The place is a stone castle courtyard by a lake, with banners, a drawbridge, and towers in the distance. On the left, a young knight in shiny armor blocks with a big shield and swings a sword. On the right, a wizard kid in a star robe and pointy hat casts a burst of sparks from a staff.
directions.note: Classic fantasy fits loot well: swords, shields, robes, and potions are easy for kids to read.

directions.name: Hometown superheroes
directions.scene: The place is a suburban street at sunset, with a skate park, a neon arcade, and a pizza shop with a striped awning. On the left, a kid in a homemade superhero costume with a cape and goggles does a trick on a skateboard and throws an energy blast. On the right, a kid in a homemade superhero costume with a mask swings a baseball bat that glows.
directions.note: Homemade costumes make skins fun and endless. The town gives arenas such as the arcade, the mall, and the school gym.

directions.name: Wild West frontier
directions.scene: The place is a desert mesa town at golden hour, with a wooden saloon, a water tower, cactus, and red rock mesas behind. On the left, a cowgirl in a hat and boots spins a glowing lasso. On the right, a kid inventor in goggles and overalls aims a steam-powered gadget arm that shoots sparks.
directions.note: The Wild West has a strong look. Steam gadgets add many fun items for the shop.
